item.title: [7] Ribbon made of carbon pentagons and heptagons has metallic properties
item.content:encoded:
Authors: Authors not available in source RSS

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Synthesis and characterization of metallic carbon nanoribbons relevant to quasi-1D and graphene systems.

Tags: #nanomaterials #carbon #electronicstructure

Abstract: Ribbons that are composed exclusively of five- and seven-carbon rings have metal-like electron transport and conductance. The ribbons can be synthesized by linking previously inaccessible chains of paired five-membered rings, providing a route to making highly conducting carbon nanoribbons.

item.title: [7] Narrow carbon pentaheptite nanoribbon as a covalent metal
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: J. G. Hou, Bing Wang

Authors: Jianmin Huang, Qitang Fan, Jie Meng, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Detailed study of covalent metallic carbon nanoribbons and their quasi-1D electronic properties.

Tags: #nanomaterials #carbon #quantumwires

Abstract: Planar carbon pentaheptite nanoribbons are synthesized by laterally fusing polypentalene chains transformed from pre-synthesized polycyclooctadiene chains, suggesting a possible route towards carbon quantum wires.

item.title: [9] Subcycle videography of Landau–Zener–Majorana transitions in graphene
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: R. Huber, U. Höfer

Authors: V. Eggers, G. Inzani, M. Meierhofer, et al.

Score 9/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Novel band-structure videography of graphene, directly aligning with user's experimental electronic structure expertise.; demoted from A: broad CM, not direct user/project hit

Tags: #method #graphene #bandstructure

Abstract: An experimental concept enabling attosecond-precision, subcycle band-structure videography covering the entire first Brillouin zone is demonstrated and used to visualize the lightwave-driven electron motion of Landau–Zener–Majorana transitions in graphene.

item.title: [9] Time-reversal-symmetry-breaking spin injection from a compensated magnet
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Helena Reichlova, Fèlix Casanova

Authors: Jone Mencos, Antonin Badura, Eoin Dolan, et al.

Score 9/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Experimental demonstration of altermagnetism and TRSB spin injection in Mn5Si3.; demoted from A: broad CM, not direct user/project hit

Tags: #material #altermagnetism #TRSB

Abstract: Experiments show that altermagnetic Mn5Si3 generates spin currents despite zero net magnetization, demonstrating a central prediction of altermagnetic spintronics.
